# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `buzzvideo` MCP server pointing at BuzzVideo's hosted endpoint (`https://webapi.buzzvideo.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with BuzzVideo account sign-in.
- Logo: references the submitted `https://buzzvideo.ai/images/logo-icon-180.png`; the file could not be downloaded when this plugin was added.
